page.title: Syllabus progress
page.subtitle: Mark how far each learner has got through the stage syllabus. Learners see their own progress in the app.
page.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

off.title: Syllabus progress is off
off.body: Switch it on in Settings to let teachers mark each learner’s progress week by week, and learners see it in their app.

noBatches.title: No batch has a syllabus yet
noBatches.body: A batch shows up here once its course stage has a syllabus of week blocks. Ask your admin to add one to the stage.

noAssigned.title: No batches assigned to you
noAssigned.body: No batches are assigned to you yet. Ask your admin to assign you to a batch.

picker.label: Batch
picker.promptBody: Pick a batch above to see each learner’s progress, week block by week block.

learner.loadFailed: Could not load this student’s progress
learner.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.
learner.noCoursesBody: This student is not in a batch whose course stage has a syllabus.
learner.markHint: Tap a week block to mark it.
learner.notYoursBody: This student is not in your batches. Ask your admin if you need to mark their progress.

batch.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.
batch.noSyllabusBody: Its course stage has no week blocks yet. Add a syllabus to the stage to start marking progress.
batch.noLearnersBody: Once learners are enrolled in this batch, they show up here.

grid.noMatchBody: Try another name or enrolment number.
grid.caption: Syllabus progress for {{batch}}

dialog.noPoints: This week block has no points listed.
dialog.notePlaceholder: What went well, what to practise next…

bulk.title: Mark weeks
bulk.weeksRequired: Choose at least one week block
bulk.noteHint: Added to every learner and week you mark.
bulk.replaceNote: This replaces the current status of these weeks for these learners.
bulk.allLearners_one: Applies to the {{count}} learner in this batch (no learner ticked).
bulk.allLearners_other: Applies to all {{count}} learners in this batch (no learner ticked).
bulk.selectedLearners_one: Applies to the {{count}} learner you ticked.
bulk.selectedLearners_other: Applies to the {{count}} learners you ticked.
